name: Sean Guy
title: Principal Psychologist and AHPRA Approved Supervisor
description: Sean is a highly experienced psychologist with over 25 years of practice working with adolescents from 13 years and adults. Sean is also a Gottman Trained Relationship Counsellor. Modalities include Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

name: Tamara Powell
title: Therapist
description: Tamara takes a holistic approach, recognising the complex ways intersectional and structural factors impact mental health and wellbeing. She has worked with people who experience disability, live with chronic illness, have mental health issues, who are ageing and those who are bereaved. Modalities include Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

name: Amanda Beattie
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker & Family Therapist
description: Adults and adolescents. Integrative, client-centred approach for issues including anxiety, depression, trauma, stress, loss and relationship difficulties. Couples counselling incorporating EFT, psychodynamic and multi-generational approaches; family therapy. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

name: Tim Slingsby
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Tim draws from Interpersonal Therapy, Attachment Therapy, CBT, ACT and Internal Family Systems Therapy, and is an accredited meditation teacher. Working from a compassionate, trauma informed angle, Tim sees that we often develop behaviours and beliefs as a way of protecting ourselves from stress and overwhelm. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

name: Thomas (Tom) Lowe
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Tom is committed to creating a space where all can feel welcome, including people who are culturally and linguistically diverse, and people from sexual and gender minorities. Draws on cognitive behavioural therapies and psychodynamic, interpersonal and attachment oriented therapies. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
specialties: sexual and gender minorities, CALD, psychodynamic

name: Kristina Spanos
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Kristina has a strong focus on trauma-informed practice, particularly in working with PTSD and trauma-related concerns. Her clinical work includes depression, anxiety, BPD, eating disorders, ADHD, and psychotic disorders, with a keen interest in women's mental health and frontline emergency workers. Funding pathways include WorkCover, EAP, NDIS, VOCAT and Medicare. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
specialties: PTSD, trauma, BPD, emergency workers, VOCAT

name: Simone Dixon
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Simone is experienced with anxiety, depression, social anxiety, phobias, stress, trauma, relationship issues, workplace challenges, and low self-esteem. Simone also enjoys working with sexual health and women's health including support during menopause. Approaches include CBT, Schema Therapy, Mindfulness, Solution Focused Therapy and ACT. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, sexual health, women's health

name: Alexis Reinheimer
title: Social Worker / Therapist
description: She provides a person-centred, trauma-informed and nonjudgmental space for young people and adults. Alexis greatly values diversity, offering a neurodiversity-affirming approach that is gender and sexuality-affirming and culturally sensitive. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

name: Julian Schokman
title: Therapist
description: Julian has extensive experience working with people with trauma, grief, addictions and difficulty with relationships, providing safety and encouragement to change patterns and heal wounds. Modalities include Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

name: Jenn Vuong
title: Holistic Counsellor
description: Drawing largely from Psychodynamic or Jungian and humanistic therapies, Jenn has a special interest in treating relationship or attachment issues, developmental or complex trauma, lack of meaning, existential concerns, spiritual crisis, shadow work and dream-work. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
specialties: complex trauma, developmental trauma, Jungian, attachment

name: Sophia Bilbrough
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Sophia has many years' experience working with diverse communities including LGBTQI+, Rainbow Mob, and refugee background Australians. Her work has focused on addressing racism and gendered inequity; she welcomes exploration of dreams, poetry and drawings during sessions. Graduate Certificate in Gestalt. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
specialties: LGBTQI+, Rainbow Mob, refugee background, Gestalt

name: Karla Dubaniewicz
title: Registered Psychologist, Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: Prior to becoming a psychologist, she spent more than 15 years supporting children, adolescents, adults, and families experiencing trauma, family violence, sexual abuse, and other complex life challenges. She works with adolescents and adults experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, and the impacts of family violence and abuse. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
specialties: trauma, sexual abuse, family violence, neurodivergent

name: Tinchu Kumar
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker & EMDR therapist
description: Tinchu Kumar is an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and EMDR therapist with over 15 years of experience. Her therapeutic approach is trauma-informed, strengths-based and tailored; she works with anxiety, depression, trauma, grief and loss, substance use and the impacts of adverse life experiences. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

name: Jen Parker
title: Clinical Hypnotherapist & Strategic Psychotherapist
description: Jen is a qualified Clinical Hypnotherapist and Strategic Psychotherapist who specialises in anxiety, low self-esteem, trauma, and behavioural change. She sees behaviours not as dysfunction but as protective patterns formed over time. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
